svg.aria-label: A steelyard on a heavy base. Its beam is graduated on a log scale of annual AI spend per employee, from $100 to $1M, one major tick for every ten times more. A black poise slides along the beam to the spend; on the short arm hangs a fixed counterweight stamped $250K, Jensen Huang's bar of half a $500,000 salary. Below the bar the beam tips toward the counterweight and the tongue at the pivot leans off LEVEL; at $250K it levels.
